many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

**Constructing JSON Grid**

g=[[8]*22 for _ in range(26)]
# panel 1: 3x3 pattern tiled over rows 2..10, cols 3..8
p1=[[0,1,0],[1,0,1],[1,1,0]]
for r in range(2,11):
 for c in range(3,9): g[r][c]=p1[(r-2)%3][(c-6)%3]
# panel 2: 2x2 pattern tiled over rows 4..11, cols 13..18
p2=[[4,0],[4,4]]
for r in range(4,12):
 for c in range(13,19): g[r][c]=p2[(r-10)%2][(c-13)%2]
# panel 3: 3x4 pattern tiled over rows 16..21, cols 3..10
p3=[[3,0,3,3],[0,3,0,3],[3,3,0,3]]
for r in range(16,22):
 for c in range(3,11): g[r][c]=p3[(r-19)%3][(c-7)%4]
import json
print(json.dumps(g,separators=(',',':')))
print('dims',len(g),{len(row) for row in g})
